insights.one_liner: Amsterdam-headquartered banking software company with about 2,000 staff worldwide, IND recognised sponsor, used by 120+ banks.

culture.text: About 2,057 people on LinkedIn, mostly engineers and IT staff from computer science backgrounds.
Very international team: top schools include AGH Krakow, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University and the University of Amsterdam.
Founded in 2003 by Jouk Pleiter, headquartered in Amsterdam with teams on every continent.

open.text: Backbase B.V., Backbase Europe B.V. and Backbase R&D B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Its one open job here, a senior software engineering role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Signed Belize Bank for a six-year digital banking overhaul.
Launched agentic banking solutions with Mastercard for its 120+ banks.
Albania's digital-only Jet Bank launched on Backbase's platform.

worth_knowing.text: Appointed Tikkie founder Roland Booijen as chief product officer to lead its push into AI-agent banking.
